basic_info.description:
Welcome to your new home in the heart of downtown San Francisco! Located at 333 Main Street, Unit 8G, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers 1,335 square feet of comfortable living.

Step inside to find a bright and open living space, perfect for hanging out or hosting friends. Large windows let in plenty of natural light and offer great views of the city, making this place feel both cozy and connected to the vibrant downtown scene. Plus, you'll love the direct access from the living room to your own private terrace, a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

You'll also enjoy the building's awesome amenities! There's a common media and recreation room for movie nights or game days, and a gym to keep fit without leaving home. Need to unwind? Check out the sauna, spa, or take a swim in the pool. The concierge is there to help with anything you need, and the elevator and garage make life easy and convenient.

This is your chance to enjoy a fantastic urban lifestyle with everything San Francisco has to offer right at your doorstep!
